reviews.title: Latest Update
reviews.text: The app worked great before the update. Now it constantly freezes and locks up. The only recourse is to force close the app and lose the data already input on a new log file. Then reopen the app and hope the same thing doesn’t happen. So far I have closed and reopened the app 15 times to log only one dive.

reviews.title: Log dive text views broken
reviews.text: Good luck logging your dives switching between text inputs is completely busted

reviews.title: Horrendous App
reviews.text:
This app is one of the most talked-about things amongst divers when we go out.

The app never saves dives properly, is full of bugs and glitches. It is literally one of the worst apps we’ve ever used to log dives.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Terrible app performance. Super buggy. Customer support is unhelpful

reviews.title: Not optimised for IOS 27
reviews.text:
The App is really struggling to work on IOS 27. All the way through the betas the app crashed and still crashing now. 

iPhone 17 pro max, iPad Pro. 
The back button when logging dives is not aligned. 

When logging dives if u start from the top as you should, when u get to add the bottom time, the app either crashes, locks up or freezes for 30 seconds between clicks. 

However if you start at the bottom and enter the bottom time it works fine. 

Easy to replicate and fault still there now. 

The app also feels sluggish and unrefined.

Not great at the moment I’m afraid.

reviews.title: Need to fix logging feature
reviews.text: Ever since I went from rescue diver to Divemaster the log a dive feature is incredibly slow and laggy. No matter what internet I am on. It take a long time to load everything please fix
